data.narrative:
Resilience is a Series D biotech & health company that has raised approximately $600M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the same sector and stage, with particular focus on 3 same-stage private peers: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two valuation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier to the $600M capital raised proxy, yielding $900M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the median valuation of $3.8B across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Resilience's revenue is not disclosed. The wide dispersion among private peers—particularly Colossal Biosciences at the $10.3B extreme—reflects heterogeneity in stage-adjusted valuations within frontier biotech.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $765M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median point estimate of $2.4B. The gap between the stage-progression method ($900M) and peer median ($3.8B) reflects uncertainty around capital efficiency and market positioning relative to disclosed peers. Key uncertainties include revenue traction (unavailable), capital deployment efficiency, and the applicability of the wide peer range given heterogeneous technical de-risking across the sample.
